svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 15 — "The Calm" — extraction underway, the moment before the turn
svg.desc: Page 15: 4 panels (half-half / full-tall / inset). The keeper leans on the gallery railing oblivious; Jink is crouched at the far end in the dark, sharing the same iron. Jink's POV: the keeper as an enormous mountain of peacoat, fingers as long as Jink is tall. Wide cinematic from across the river: lighthouse beam sweeping, keeper silhouette on gallery, Wren descending the exterior stonework. Inset close-up of Wren's face — quiet satisfaction, the rare upturn at the corner of her mouth. The calm before the sighting.
